findings.title: C5 omits oneOf nested unknown-field diagnostics

summary: Independent read-only design review found one ambiguity in C5. Unknown keys inside oneOf discriminated objects currently produce a safe parent-level oneOf constraint, while the amendment describes an unexpected-property diagnostic. Clarify which result is accepted and cover these nested objects in safety tests. The Schema corrections and REVIEW/V1 classification are otherwise sound. The prior owner approval does not cover this amended spec.
